title: Gallery walls beside factory-finished frames

paragraphs.text: Paint the gallery walls only. The new powder-coated window frames are to stay as supplied.
The delivery docket describes the frames as paint-ready in a generic product family heading. These particular frames are factory finished; no field coating has been requested.
A volunteer would prefer all trim blue, but has no authority to change the order.
Walls only in the selected white. Protect the factory-finished frames and do not field-paint them. Include cleanup and removal of masking.
Prepare and paint gallery walls white; mask and protect factory-finished frames, leave their finish intact, remove masking and clean up.
